home.categoriesIntro: Find local businesses, services, organisations and resources organised by category.
home.welcomeText: Welcome to GUIAPINEDA, the guide to local businesses, services, organisations and resources in Pineda de Mar, and to everything happening around town.
home.businessCtaTitle: Do you run a business or offer a service in Pineda?
home.businessCtaText: Join GUIAPINEDA and help more people find you. We are preparing a clear and simple way for you to add your activity.

comunicats.title: Announcements
comunicats.submitTitle: Do you want to publish an announcement?
comunicats.submitText1: If you are part of a local association, group or organisation and want to announce an activity, event or information of public interest, you can send us your announcement by email.
comunicats.submitText2: Announcements will be reviewed before publication. GUIAPINEDA reserves the right not to publish offensive, defamatory or inappropriate content.
comunicats.empty: There are no announcements published yet.
comunicats.introTitle: Information about Pineda, shared by its people
comunicats.introText: Activities, initiatives, notices and information of local interest shared by organisations, groups, businesses and residents of Pineda de Mar.
comunicats.ctaText: Share a contribution of interest to Pineda de Mar.
comunicats.ctaNote: All contributions are subject to editorial review by GUIAPINEDA before publication. Submission does not guarantee publication.

comercios.missingInfo: GUIAPINEDA grows with the participation of local businesses. If you cannot find a business, it may simply not have sent us its information yet.
comercios.emptyText: There are no businesses published in this section yet.

millores.title: Improving Pineda
millores.introTitle: Ideas, issues and proposals to improve Pineda de Mar
millores.introText: An open space for residents and visitors to share issues, civic concerns and constructive proposals that may help improve Pineda de Mar.
millores.filterHelp: Filter contributions by type or area of Pineda de Mar.
millores.submitTitle: Would you like to suggest an improvement?
millores.submitText1: This section collects issues, proposals and civic matters that may help improve Pineda de Mar.
millores.submitText2: All submissions are reviewed before publication and must keep a respectful and constructive tone.
millores.submitEmailText: You can send your proposal to
millores.empty: There are no posts in Improving Pineda yet.

fotoMes.label: Photo of the month
fotoMes.modalTitle: Participate in the Photo of the month
fotoMes.modalIntro: You can send your photographs of Pineda de Mar to participate in the GUIAPINEDA Photo of the month section.
fotoMes.rule1: Photographs must be taken in Pineda de Mar.
fotoMes.rule2: Horizontal format and good quality are recommended.
fotoMes.rule4: Do not send close-up photos of minors or people without permission.
fotoMes.rule5: GUIAPINEDA reserves the right of selection and publication.
fotoMes.pageIntro: Send your photograph of Pineda de Mar to participate in GUIAPINEDA’s Photo of the month.
fotoMes.formPhotoHelp: Allowed formats: JPG, PNG or WEBP. Recommended maximum: 5 MB.
fotoMes.formAccept: I confirm that I am the author of the photograph and accept that GUIAPINEDA may review it and publish it if selected.
fotoMes.homeIntro: Share your view of Pineda de Mar. Each month we select a photograph that highlights the places, moments and people that make the town special.
